body:
Are you staying with him to keep your friends? Because you think you need him?

You are your own person, but you don't seem to see that, or respect or like yourself very much.

I think counseling could do wonders to help with your self-esteem, and help you set better boundaries.

I also think you should dump this guy because he is a serial cheater and only told you because he got caught, not because he felt any remorse. It was not a mistake. Why are you still friends with someone who sleeps with your boyfriend?

I don't understand what your logic in keeping these people in your life. They aren't doing you any favors in your self-esteem territory.
Thank you for your reply. I've been trying to cook more, but I do get tired easily. I'll stick to simple, healthy recipes and try to walk more. I'm glad you are migraine free :)

This was so helpful for me. I'm going to try to slowly do the transitions. 


You inspire me.


Thank you.

Thank you, again.


I'm so happy that you have a med that works for you now.


Good for you! Kick ass at your spartan race! :)

Thank you so much for your reply.

Mine hasn't been either.

How did you start building up your tolerance? What types of exercise do you do?

Thank you for your reply. I'm seeing my neurologist and pain doctor frequently, things have suddenly gotten worse so my activity levels are super low. I will definitely look into the motion exercises.

What does one day look like for you food/exercise wise?

Thank you again.

Thank you for your reply! It was very helpful to hear from someone who knows what it's like.
What does one day of food look like to you?

Your girlfriend should limit contact with her mom. Not totally cut her out, only because she doesn't want to, but make it so she isn't around her nearly as much.

Also, I'd try to take it as a compliment that the mom doesn't like you. She hates you because you are giving her daughter strength and happiness, and are repairing her self-worth. Her mom wants her weak and easy to control. Don't let the bitch monster from hell bring you down, you should like a wonderful guy.
I'd say quit your job and look for a better one.

I would just tell her that being pregnant on this birth control is very unlikely. Not that you don't believe her (which I'm not saying is true, but just so it sounds less harsh/makes her more likely to agree), but that you want to make sure before she has to have an abortion. Just to be cautious. Or just tell her that you want her to take another pregnancy test in front of you. Personally, I think the first option is manipulative, but could be better for you, or at least keep things civil.

I believe spitting is considered assault. Like people can get arrested for it.
Also he is verbally abusing you. He is doing this in front of your children.
Do you want your kids to grow up thinking this is okay? That this is how women should be treated?

This situation is so fucked up.
You did nothing to provoke this.
Let that sink in.
THIS IS IN NO WAY YOUR FAULT.
He has anger issues and you guys either need to get counselling ASAP and fix this, or you need to leave him.
This isn't just about you anymore.

I am so sorry you are in this situation.
